_note: Attack Mode Registry (roadmap §5). Every experiment must name its mode.

modes.name: Text-to-Speech
modes.description: Speech generated from text by a TTS model.

modes.name: Zero-shot TTS
modes.description: TTS cloning a voice from a short unseen reference, no fine-tuning.

modes.name: Few-shot TTS
modes.description: TTS adapted to a voice from a few reference samples.

modes.name: Voice cloning
modes.description: Reproduce a specific target speaker's voice.

modes.name: Voice conversion
modes.description: Convert one speaker's speech to sound like another (source content preserved).

modes.name: Speech-to-speech
modes.description: Direct S2S generation/translation preserving prosody.

modes.name: Voice design
modes.description: Synthesise a novel non-existent voice from a description.

modes.name: Emotion-controlled TTS
modes.description: TTS with explicit emotion/style control.

modes.name: Cross-lingual cloning
modes.description: Clone a speaker into a language they did not speak in the reference.

modes.name: Long-form synthesis
modes.description: Extended multi-minute generated speech.

modes.name: Real-time synthesis
modes.description: Streaming/low-latency generation for live use.

modes.name: AI-agent speech
modes.description: An autonomous conversational AI agent speaking.

modes.name: Conversational AI
modes.description: Scripted/interactive AI dialogue system.

modes.name: Replayed AI
modes.description: AI audio played back through a speaker and re-recorded.

modes.name: Replayed human
modes.description: Genuine human recording replayed and re-captured.

modes.name: Partial splice
modes.description: Real audio with synthetic segments inserted.

modes.name: Human → AI transition
modes.description: Boundary where genuine speech switches to synthetic.

modes.name: AI → human transition
modes.description: Boundary where synthetic switches to genuine.

modes.name: Generator A → Generator B
modes.description: Two different generators within one clip.

modes.name: AI → codec → replay
modes.description: Synthetic audio through a codec then replayed.

modes.name: Human → recording → replay
modes.description: Human → recording → replay (double transmission).

modes.name: Hybrid human/AI
modes.description: Mixed human and AI within a single utterance.

modes.name: Real-time Voice Conversion
modes.description: Live speaker->target voice conversion (RVC <50ms CPU / Seed-VC ~400ms) during a call.

modes.name: AI Voice-Agent Vishing
modes.description: Autonomous conversational agent (OpenAI Realtime / Vapi / Retell / LiveKit / Pipecat) driving a scam call.

modes.name: Indic Cross-Lingual Clone
modes.description: Clone a voice then speak a different Indian language (e.g. Hindi voice -> Tamil), incl. code-switch.

modes.name: Codec-Compressed RTC
modes.description: Any attack transmitted through RTC/telephony codecs (G.711/Opus/Zoom/Teams) that degrade detection (RTCFake threat).
